name: the-four-dollar-pill
why: Opens on a $4 bottle karate-chopping long COVID down 41%; the N.I.H.'s stamp runs out of the frame, the drug company laughs its cap off at SPONSOR WANTED, and the scale smashes through the floor at 7,083 to 1 while the little trial bundle sails off on tiptoe.

name: the-dartboard
why: Opens on "zero point zero seven. That is not a typo" over a scatter of cigar-smoking germs; a drunk on the pavement out-allocates 20,000 staff with an over-the-shoulder bullseye, and the payoff is the committee dividing like a virus until the plaque reads ADVISORY PANELS.

name: kept-the-disease
why: Opens on patients begging at the glass of a fridge full of the antibodies that put long COVID into remission; the rules padlock the door shut, the doses go furry, and the Capitol tips the medicine in the bin and walks the virus home on a leash.
